content: Abun, bweel nà Ayudà bye alà? Mfun a nkyɛɛy nkye?
Mfun yà unsà indiir mbɔɔn! Ntɔn Ndaa a Nzam bàtwab atàpa akà ba. -
Ininà? Isàkal naa bàmbɔɔn uboo a ba bàkäl anki bàlää, nkye ukɔɔn lää aba alà làyàlwom lää a Nzam?
Kabwɛy anki! Wɛy Nzam bun'yöb naa nde wà ndandaa, mbuur wanswà wà mbuur a loor, asànaa bàsön ya naa:

content.text: « Yubwaŋ bayöb naa ngye awà balàbal unsà ndaa angye,
naa ngye afàwal iböŋ isàkal naa bàmatsüül nsaŋ. »

content: Wɛɛ bi itɛn aben, isàkal naa un'kɔɔl aŋàyɔŋ abi afàsà balàbal a Nzam ukɔl? Nkye Nzam kà we anà un'kɔɔl aŋàyɔŋ anki kidwa nde unsà nkyɛl ande? Mɛ in'wàmutɛn unsà an'kyän a imbuur.
Kabwɛy anki! Ntɔn abun, Nzam mɛɛn nsaŋ asun'tsüül aben?
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa u mbwo a loor amɛ, ndandaa a Nzam ifàpää mbɔɔn ntɔn làkoo ande, ntɔn nkye, mɛ, tii lalà ban'tsüülà ba nsaŋ asànaa mbuur un'be?
Abun, ntɔn nkye mpa ban'kwo mutɛn naa: « Wɛy bi ikyer ube ntɔn ubwaŋ bàtoo mwo »? Ntɔn baar amwɛy bàfibämà naa bi bàfàlɔŋ abwɛy. Baar aban ban'kwo muwal ntaaŋàmbar!
Mbuur a balàbal watɛy
Wɛɛ ininà? Bi Ayudà, bweel nà bi ifàkal alà? Akà ikikye! Ntɔn bi bàkyàtsul mbar naa baar banswà, Ayudà asànaa Angɛlɛki, bà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b a man'be.
Asànaa bàsön ya naa:

content.text: « Mbuur a balàbal watɛy, itàkal akà mwɛy,
Akà mwɛy afàkyer ubwaŋ watɛy, itàkal akà mwɛy mpɛl.
Un'kwaal aba wà asànaa an'dii aŋàduub,
an'te a ntäy mà ungyɛl a itɔ̈ɔ̈m aba.
Mun aba wàŋàyɔl a in'küül anà buul.
In'kɔl aba myà nswɛy mupay an'kil,
Ntɛɛl a upay anà ngyɛb yà u mbwo a ba,
anà mbwo a duu ba bàyöb anki.
Bɔɔmà a Nzam akà ikikye u mii a ba latɛy. »
Kyekà, bi bàkyàyöb naa ndaa yanswà kan'tɛn un'kɔɔn, wa kan'tɛn akà baar abà u ngyɛl a un'kɔɔn, ntɔn mun wanswà ukäl wàŋàbäm anà mɛɛn manswà màŋàkwàndwà u mii a Nzam.
Wɛɛ, akà mbuur mwɛy usàmɛnà anki wàbalàbal kusà a nde u mbwo a isal a un'kɔɔn, ntɔn un'kɔɔn aswaŋà nà man'be mpɛl.

content: Làkwikilà làfàpà balàbal
Wɛɛ apanà, u nsaay a un'kɔɔn, balàbal a Nzam làkyer amɛnà, un'kɔɔn anà aŋangɔɔm bun'tɛɛlà imbäl.
La là balàbal a Nzam u mbwo a làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ ntɔn baar banswà bàfun'kyey, ntɔn nsöön yatɛy:
ba banswà bàkyer man'be, anà batsüŋ làkoo a Nzam.
Wɛɛ ba batwey bàngway balàbal u mbwo a kab a ngway ande ntɔn ntsuuŋà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Nzam nde kàpɛ asànaa ibɔɔn musɔŋ man'be a baar u mbwo a làkwikilà. Ibɔɔn aki iswaŋà balàbal a Nzam, mpa kàpɛ nde ntaaŋàmbar akà man'be bàkyer itaan,
utaaŋ a nkääŋ a mpem ande, ntɔn muswaŋ balàbal ande u taaŋ alà ntɔn nde ukäl wàbalàbal anà mutwey balàbal a mbuur kan'sà làkwikilà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Nkye apanà we anà undiir afàkyey uyɔl? Akà mwɛy watɛy! Ntɔn nkye? Unsà un'kɔɔn nà? Nkye wà isal? Ŋaa, wɛɛ kà un'kɔɔn a làkwikilà.
Bi bàkyàyöb naa mbuur afàtoo wàbalàbal u mbwo a làkwikilà, wɛɛ kà u mbwo a isal a un'kɔɔn anki.
Isàkal abwɛy, nkye Nzam wà Nzam a Ayudà mpɛl? Nkye Nde kà wà Nzam a in'sɛŋ myumwɛy anki? Ya yà ndandaa naa nde sye wà Nzam a in'sɛŋ myumwɛy,
ntɔn Nzam wà mwɛy: Nde asàtwey balàbal baar aŋàkyɛy u mbwo a làkwikilà, anà baar mpa abàŋàkyɛy u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Nkye apanà, ikaswaŋà naa u mbwo a làkwikilà bi kan'lwom un'kɔɔn? Ŋaa, bi kan'pà wa ngwal.
